name: timestamp each event as max(seen) + 1
mechanism: each process keeps a counter, increments it for each local event, attaches it to every message, and on receipt sets the counter to the maximum of its own and the received value plus one, so causally later events always carry larger stamps

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Lamport ordering' in section Distributed systems algorithms: a partial ordering of events based on the happened-before relation

fails_when: concurrent events are also ordered, so the stamp cannot tell concurrency from causality (the vector form can)
